regions.name: Nam Khwe River
regions.quote: In images the Nam Khwe River, Myanmar contains quite shallow, turbid, moderately fast-flowing water; the substrate is composed of variably-sized boulders with some relatively little streamside vegetation.

regions.name: Nam Lawe River
regions.quote: Sympatric species include Danio albolineatus plus unidentified members of Barilius and Opsarius. In the larger Nam Lawe River, also Myanmar, it lives alongside Badis ruber, Colisa labiosa, Lepidocephalichthys berdmorei and an unidentified Danio species.
